d:
When Monstercat and WHIPPED CREAM reached out to us for a collaboration, you best believe we couldn’t say no. On this project, some of our Chillhop favorites have taken on remix duties for nine tracks off 's debut album ‘HOME WAS ALWAYS ME,’ infusing them with their own lofi and chill electronic touch. The first official collaboration between Chillhop Music and this one has some unexpected twists and turns; press play and see where it takes you.
